payload.name: Interpretive Load
payload.fact: Interpretive load is the cognitive labour required to reconstruct meaning, intent, priority, and operational direction from incomplete organisational signals.
payload.boundary: Distinguished from role ambiguity, task complexity, information overload, and cognitive load; specifically concerns the structural work required to transform incomplete signals into executable meaning.
